identity.name: magnum-v2-72b
identity.summary: This is the seventh model in a series aimed at replicating the prose quality of Claude 3 models, specifically Sonnet and Opus.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card provides no evaluation results, training data details, or inner-workings info for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not state the provenance or usage terms of the fine-tuning data used to adapt Qwen-2 72B Instruct.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card only says it aims to replicate prose quality of Claude 3 models and gives no intended-use or misuse definition.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives no documentation of the fine-tuning dataset, its collection, curation, or synthetic-data generation.

possible_risks.description: Terms of service, licenses, or other rules restrict the use of certain models.
possible_risks.justification: License is listed only as 'other' with no terms stated, leaving usage restrictions unclear.

specifications.model_size: 135.4 GiB of safetensors weights (145,412,518,832 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was produced by full-parameter fine-tuning of Qwen-2 72B Instruct for two epochs using 8x AMD Instinct MI300X accelerators. Training used a weight decay of 0.01 and a peak learning rate of 4e-6, with sample packing for 16k tokens.
